name: restaurant-qr-ordering-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Restaurant QR Code Table Booking and Ordering System

scripts.start: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "AUTH:8081,CATALOG:8082,BOOKING:8083,FRONTEND:5173" -c "blue,green,magenta,yellow" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:catalog" "npm run start:booking" "npm run start:frontend"
scripts.start:backend: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "AUTH:8081,CATALOG:8082,BOOKING:8083" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run start:auth" "npm run start:catalog" "npm run start:booking"
scripts.verify: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
